messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-92764 triggered for service=embeddings-ingest env=prod - error_rate 5xx > 4.5% (2m)
ops-oncall: acked INC-92764, I'm on it — starting triage. Paging @anna @raj @morgan
anna: oncall ack, joining. quick glance: load looks normal but 502s from upstream-cache-proxy
raj: same, lots of upstream reset entries  `upstream reset: ECONNRESET` from 10.12.8.0/24
morgan: tailing logs now, seeing repeated client retries with 3xx->5xx loop from a small set of API keys
liz: pd-bot shows spike started at 1819998850, correlated with a deploy? checking deployment history
pd-bot: Deploybot: rollout embeddings-ingest/2026.3.77 finished at 1819998600 (10% canary then promoted)
ops-oncall: rollback not yet. first step: enable per-key rate limiting and temporary circuit-breaker for high-error keys
anna: adding rate limit rule: `rlimit: embeddings_ingest key_rate=10/s` — pushing now (edge rule)
raj: confirmation: applying rule to edge firewall, hitting it with `curl` to validate
morgan: small reproducer: `for i in 1..50; do curl -s -H "Authorization: ApiKey X" https://embeds.prod/api/v1/encode; done` — when key X retries aggressively we get 502s downstream
ops-oncall: mitigation: added temporary 10r/s soft-limit + 429 fallback. Asking CD team to pause any aggressive clients (CS reachout)
liz: CS pinged the customer linked to key X, they admitted a batch job misconfigured retry backoff, pausing on their side :phone:
anna: starting shallow rollback of the last canary batch (moving traffic away from node group ga-7) — will monitor error rate
raj: tail shows error rate dropping in eu-west after traffic shift 
ops-oncall: good sign. keeping the circuit-breaker in place for 30m; will lift once 5xx < 0.5% for 15m
morgan: note for postmortem: consider server-side throttling by submission pattern (burst detection) and better retry-backoff guidance in docs
anna: adding runbook snippet in thread: ```runbook: if 5xx spike due to retries -> enable per-key soft rate-limit, shift traffic to healthy pool, notify customer, consider rollback```
ops-oncall: handoff in 40m to night oncall if stable. tagging for follow-up: @liz for CS comms, @raj for logs/artifact collection, @morgan for postmortem writeup :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INC-92764 status: acknowledged -> investigating.
pd-bot: INC-92764 escalated to SEV2 (auto) due to customer impact metric above threshold
ops-oncall: will update PD timeline and close when stable and follow-up tasks created.
anna: final check at 1819999800: 5xx at 0.22% over last 10m, traffic normalized. handing off to next oncall. :white_check_mark:
